tagline: Leading European provider of comprehensive insurance and financial solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: The Fee-Ergebnis reflects the performance of asset management and financial services activities, a structural pillar of Swiss Life's business model.

kpis.name: Fee Result
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from asset management and financial services fees.
kpis.description: The fee result reflects the performance of asset management activities, a core pillar of Swiss Life's business model. The 33% growth between 2023 and 2024 is primarily attributable to the strong performance of Swiss Life Asset Managers.
kpis.signal: Dynamic growth in recurring revenue driven by asset management

kpis.name: Net Profit
kpis.explanation: Profit after taxes for the entire group.
kpis.description: Net profit increased significantly to CHF 1,261 million (+13% vs 2023), supported by efficient cost management and strong investment performance.
kpis.signal: Significant improvement in net profit in 2024

kpis.name: Operating Profit
kpis.explanation: Result from core operations before exceptional items.
kpis.description: Operating profit rose significantly to CHF 1,783 million, driven by strong performance in both Swiss and international segments as well as robust growth in fee income.
kpis.signal: Robust improvement in operating profit supported across all segments

kpis.name: Return on Equity
kpis.explanation: Profitability generated for shareholders relative to equity.
kpis.description: ROE reached 16.6% in 2024, reflecting prudent capital management and increasing internal generation of equity.
kpis.signal: Continued improvement in return on equity

kpis.name: Dividend Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Portion of net profit distributed to shareholders as dividends.
kpis.description: The payout ratio moderates to 81% (based on the Board of Directors' proposal for 2024), reflecting a balance between shareholder commitment and retained strategic investment capacity.
kpis.signal: Moderation in payout ratio, maintenance of financial flexibility

kpis.name: Cash Transfer to Holding
kpis.explanation: Amount transferred by operating subsidiaries to the parent company to fund strategic investments and shareholder distributions.
kpis.description: The increase in cash transfer to CHF 1,308 million strengthens the group's financial flexibility for share buybacks, strategic investments, and dividends.
kpis.signal: Substantial increase in cash available at the holding for acquisitions and distributions

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of 36.5 CHF in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 fiscal years reported.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of 0.991 Bn CHF in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends Paid / Net Income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Portion of net income distributed as dividends: 80.5% in the latest year.

risks.title: Mortality and Longevity Risk
risks.score_rationale: Risk identified at the beginning of the section (strong position), direct language « Risikofaktoren sind Sterblichkeit, Langlebigkeit » without mitigation, stable but structural trend in life insurance activities, major industrial category for insurer.

risks.title: Cost and Inflation Risk
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly identified as a major risk factor, impactful language « Änderungen der Risikoanpassung wirkt sich positiv/negativ », complex inflation modeling mentioned, increased relevance due to current inflationary environment, high weight for insurer.

risks.title: Underlying Asset Revaluation Risk
risks.score_rationale: Major risk for VFA contracts (direct participation), strong impact language « Änderungen des Fair Value der zugrunde liegenden Referenzwerte », central position in IFRS 17 methodology, increased trend due to market volatility, high weight for asset-liability management.

risks.title: Deficit Contracts Risk
risks.score_rationale: Explicit risk « belastende Verträge » mentioned multiple times, impact language « Verlust » and « Verbindlichkeit », central in IFRS 17 structure, stable but structural trend, high weight for profitability.

risks.title: Technical Provisions Revaluation Risk
risks.score_rationale: Risk of revision of actuarial estimates explicitly mentioned « Änderungen der Schätzungen zukünftiger Mittelflüsse », central in methodology, moderate language « Änderungen », stable but recurring trend, medium-high weight for balance sheet.

risks.title: Discount Rate Risk
risks.score_rationale: Major implicit risk via « aktueller Abzinsungssätze » mentioned multiple times, direct impact on present value of cash flows, central in IFRS 17, increased trend due to interest rate volatility, high weight for valuation.

risks.title: Surrender and Customer Behavior Risk
risks.score_rationale: Surrender risk (Rückkauf) identified at the beginning of the section, impact on future cash flows, neutral language but material impact, stable but structural trend, medium weight for life insurer.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence in the provided documents. Swiss Life does not position AI as a strategic lever in its 2024 annual report.
evidence: No reference to AI in strategy, innovation, or risk sections
Absence of KPIs related to AI adoption or investments
